setup_steps: Choose a safe, short, repeatable non-combat route with the mini-map continuously visible.
Use the same starting position, character, window size, graphics settings, UI scale, and initial camera direction for every take.
Queue the take, return focus to Genshin Impact, and perform the route naturally without recorder commands.
post_take_policy: Confirm or correct the complete route boundary after each take.
completion_evidence: The same selected endpoint and surrounding scene are visible.
claims_boundary: Genshin PC acquisition and route-descriptor POC; no autonomous replay or combat validation.
